changes.title: Sigils defend area
items: A sigil placed in any area now has its animals defend that whole area (as home's did), plus the usual radius round the sigil

changes.title: One cooldown
items: One trail, one cooldown: her dodge and her take-off share a cooldown, and her glowing trail now runs along her dodge too, as long as the cooldown has left to run (pause-page sliders for each amount)

changes.title: Sigil runs
items: Sigils in runs: hold the sigil button after picking one up and she keeps picking up every sigil she runs over; hold it after putting one down and each empty spot she walks into takes the next
Gamepad: triangle puts your hat down and picks it up, circle cycles your sigils, the broom's spell is the left stick pressed in
